author: KuraikageMike
quote: Let’s just face it GTA6 doesn’t feel like a GTA game. The story is pretty standard. Not amazing at all. Kinda of generic. You spend your “tutorial” doing chores. The devs realize this is a game to feel like a criminal right? But the story is the opposite of that. You follow the main characters trying to get out of crime. If this was a tv show it wouldn’t be bad but as a player it’s the worst thing in the world. GTA is known for committing crimes as a type of escapism. Why would the story take the exact opposite goal most of us play the game for? The graphics are beautiful but it’s comparable to the Remake of Ocarina of time the only difference is art style. The bugs are crazy as well. I have lost parts of my body in first couple hours of gameplay. It’s whenever frames dropped. I don’t know if that’s a coincidence but regardless I kinda of what to see my badass looking character. As i have been playing this it reminds me of an episode of Lucifer when there was a gang war. The only difference now is super powered middle man. The only good parts of the game thus far are the funny troll things where you can kill or help furries. Speaking of that there is a morale system in the game. So I see what they were trying to do which is copy other games that have something similar but it doesn’t work in a story telling system for gta. Games like Fallout, Elder Scrolls, Infamous and etc could do this in past because of the setting. GTA is about committing crimes. Most people are going to be bad. The only reason they would add this is to hope that you would replay the game. My last complaint is the world feels too big it makes driving start to feel old after awhile. I almost feel like I’m commuting to work. 0/10 if it was a different genre my review would be higher.
